name: Lin Nem
source:
A cute girl who has been aware of her identity as a Nitya since she was a child, and who bears the destiny of being the 14th leader of the religious nation, of the Nemu Church... She has the ability to predict the future, and despite her appearance, she is a skilled martial artist.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char05.html]Mink[/url]]
